description: The Domestic Workers Minimum Wages Order, SI No. 49 of 2023. The Ministry of Labour publishes SI 48 and SI 50 but never uploaded SI 49, and Gazettes.Africa holds no 2023 supplements, so the official copy is ILO NATLEX record ZMB-2023-R-118201: a scan of the Government Printer's supplement to Gazette No. 7522 of 24 November 2023, pp. 299-300 (scanned 2 December 2023). Checked against the Gazette's contents list (SI 49 at p. 299), SI 48 ending at p. 298 and SI 50 starting at p. 301, and the signature block shared with SI 48 (Lusaka, 20 November 2023, B. M. Tambatamba, [MLSS.64/9/9]). The scan's embedded text layer misreads K1,100.00 as 'KI, 100.00', so the parser reads a transcription checked against the page images.
